description: The article recommends giving assistant surgeons active roles in robotic gastrectomy so that training continues despite declining laparoscopic case numbers.
title: Use active patient-side surgeon roles in robotic surgery to maintain trainee motivation and laparoscopic proficiency when laparoscopic case volume declines

title: Integrate collaborative videomaking (DST) into STEM-A and CLIL courses as an authentic, student-centred literacy activity
